acceptanceCriteria.text: The 'processing change requests' sub-step under QA Review is PRESENT iff the task has >=1 OPEN CR (reachable via CR.task, status=Open). The processing-CR sub-step is maintained in the SAME UnitController.apply seam transaction as the changeRequests[] edit (task-policy.ts:116) - a separate push is lost. (architect b408de988)
The sub-step is CHECKED iff ALL the task's CRs are resolved; while any is open it stays [ ].

While any CR is open, the TOP-LEVEL QA Review box is unticked [ ] with the processing-CR sub-step, and the DERIVED status is the QA-Review-with-open-CR band (NOT clean QA-Review, NOT In-Progress, NOT Done; Done gated on zero open CRs) - NEVER In Progress and NEVER clean QA-Review. Depends on CR-5 AC-substep-aware-band (deriveStatusEnum reads the open processing-CR). This resolves the tension between Tron's unticked-QA-Review sketch and his no-regress-to-In-Progress rule.
The sub-step is DERIVED from the open-CR set, not a stored flag (depends on CR 461d5db6 derived status).

SUPERSEDES the captured wording '77c2086c: QA Review stays [x]' — Tron's new shape (QA Review [ ] + processing-CR sub-step) WINS. Verify-owner-first: 77c2086c minted NO requirement unit (session context.md text only, 0 scenario/index files), so no prior AC/Test credit to preserve; old wording retired explicitly, not silently kept.
Seed a task with an open CR whose checklist lacks the sub-step (or shows QA Review [x]) -> RED.
CR open/resolve edits the checklist -> ViewBus.notify(task) -> sub-step + badge render live, no reload.

dependsOn.why: CR-2 (processing-CR sub-step) requires CR-5 deriveStatusEnum to be SUB-STEP AWARE so the unticked-QA-Review + open-processing-CR derives the QA-Review-with-open-CR band (NOT clean QA-Review, NOT In-Progress, NOT Done; Done gated on zero open CRs), not In-Progress. Without the derivation extension the sub-step is decorative and unticking QA Review regresses to In-Progress = the exact regress Tron forbade.
